_description: priorWorkingMagi populates the IRMAA 2-year lookback for the first two retirement years.
_rationale: Single filer retires at 65 in Florida with priorWorkingMagi = $300k (last working year's MAGI). 2024 single tier 5 ($193k–$500k) → $458.50/mo × 12 = $5,502/yr per enrollee × 1 enrollee = $5,502 surcharge in both year 0 and year 1. No income, no spending — IRMAA is paid from the $100k Roth account. By year 2 the lookback returns to the in-sim history (breakdowns[0] MAGI = 0), so surcharge drops to 0. inflationRate = 0 keeps tier thresholds at 2024 levels.
name: IRMAA Pre-Retirement MAGI
